title: A brother's C-melody saxophone
summary: One brother tried to learn music on a C-melody saxophone and gave up; Thomas says it suits a church organ, not an orchestra.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Have any brothers or sisters that learned music?
Well, one brother, he was trying to learn, but he had the wrong kind of instrument. He had a C melody saxophone and it didn't go so good with it. Well, he didn't try since that.
Nowadays, nobody plays that C melody anymore. No, no one.
I never heard of anyone playing it. See, it goes with a church organ, I think. Yeah. Yes. But otherwise, it's not good for, you know, for orchestra. Yes.
